# gpui-pre-windows (copy with one change)

Copy of [`gpui-pre-windows` 0.3.6](https://crates.io/crates/gpui-pre-windows)
(Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE-APACHE`) with a single change in `build.rs`:

- On Windows it compiles the HLSL shaders with `fxc.exe`, like the original.
- When building **for Windows from Linux or macOS** (where there is no
  `fxc.exe`) it copies `precompiled/shaders_bytes.rs`, the same shaders
  already compiled.

`precompiled/shaders_bytes.rs` is generated by `scripts/gen-windows-shaders.sh`,
which runs the Windows SDK's `fxc.exe` under Wine with the same arguments as
the original `build.rs`. Regenerate it when updating `gpui-pre` (`build.rs`
warns if the version does not match).

This is how `scripts/release-local.sh` builds the app for Windows (with
mingw-w64, target `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`):

```sh
rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
```
